newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RAMSAY HEALTH CARE TO FLOAT, RAISE A$80 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: RAMSAY HEALTH CARE TO FLOAT, RAISE A$80 MILLION.

text.p: Hospital operator Ramsay Healthcare Ltd said on Tuesday that it would seek a listing on the Australian Stock Exchange and raise about A$80 million through the issue of 43.5 million shares.
The company declined to release any other details of the issue until the prospectus was registered by the Australian Securities Comission.
Ramsay operates 13 hospitals and is building two more over the next 12 to 18 months. It employs about 2,500 people.
The company has turnover of about A$180 million and it ha said previously it expected this to rise by about A$40 million by the year to June 30, 1999.
In the 1995/96 year, Ramsay posted earnings before interest and tax of A$20.6 million.
